Delhi High Court Bans DUSU Victory Processions Amid Violence Concerns

The Delhi High Court has prohibited victory processions following the Delhi University Students' Union (DUSU) elections, citing concerns over student misconduct and hooliganism. The court issued a stern warning that violations would be met with contempt of court actions. It also indicated a willingness to halt the announcement of DUSU poll results if campus violence persists, stating 'enough is enough'.
